summary: Phase 2 (voices + mic) tested on backend and frontend, plus a Phase 1 regression. Backend: 31/31 pytest passed (8 new TTS tests and the 23 existing Phase 1 API tests). The ElevenLabs key is invalid (ElevenLabs returns 401), so audio playback for JRN-49/50/51/52/55 is BLOCKED BY KEY and could not be tested. What I could check: the backend logs 'tts elevenlabs call voice=<id> model=eleven_flash_v2_5' with the right voice id for each owner, POST /api/tts returns 204 with X-TTS-Status: error, and /api/tts/stats counts calls and failures. On the client the fallback is silent: the voice log shows text-only, no subtitle, no error UI and no console errors, and the text still shows in the chat log and the 3D bubble. JRN-53, 54, 56, 57, 58, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63 and 64 all PASS. Phase 1 regression PASS: needs and trust filled through the seeded fallback, taboo complaint on white chrysanthemum, arrange, resume after a page refresh (placements kept), storm (T3 banner, countdown, skip), 3-star score card with HK$440 receipt, and Start a new run back to the start screen.

minor.issue: When the 4 s timeout fires, the shielded ElevenLabs task keeps running, but its result is never cached. A late success is thrown away and the next request for the same line calls ElevenLabs again.
Failures are not cached even briefly, so with a bad key every owner line makes a new call that fails with 401. This is fine for correctness but wastes quota and log space.

ui_bugs.issue: No onCancel handler. If the name mic is cancelled or hits the 8 s silence after interim words, the interim text stays in player-name-input instead of going back to what was there before. The talk Composer handles this correctly.

issues: The mic button makes the text input narrower, so the placeholder is cut off ('Say something to Uncle Wir…'). Shorten the placeholder or make the panel or input wider.

action_items: Supply a valid ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, then retest audio journeys JRN-49/50/51/52/55 (playback, owner-subtitle, bob, cache hit on repeat).
Optional: add onCancel to the NameStep MicButton so the box goes back to its earlier value.
Optional: cache the result of a TTS task that finishes after the timeout; shorten the talk input placeholder.
critical_code_review_comments: tts.py: the cache write only happens on the awaiting path. Add a done-callback that caches a successful task result, so late results after a timeout are kept.

The ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is only in the backend process environment (not in backend/.env). Fixed-string search for it found 0 hits in bundle.js, frontend src/public, and all /api response bodies and headers seen during play.
mic.js: startMic always calls stopVoice (verified: store.speaking goes back to null). Simulated sessions do not request getUserMedia, which is good for CI.
Test files placed under /app/backend/tests trigger a WatchFiles hot reload of the backend, which resets the in-memory TTS cache and stats. Expect /api/tts/stats to reset to 0.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable Phase 2 journeys (JRN-53..64); JRN-49/50/51/52/55 blocked by invalid key

seed_data_creation: None. The app is stateless apart from browser localStorage; TTS test texts are prefixed TEST_ and only touch the in-memory cache.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth. Run pytest with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. The key leak test reads ELEVENLABS_API_KEY from the environment; get it from /proc/<uvicorn pid>/environ, because it is not in backend/.env. UI flow: open-stall-button > player-name-input > start-game-button > skip-cinematic-button > mouse click at __fache.project('truck-wing'). In fallback mode these messages fill all needs and trust 4: budget, colours, 'What do you hope the flowers will do?', 'Any flowers you dislike?', 'Who started this truck?', 'Tell me about your father'. The start-arranging-button click needs no_wait_after/force (the panel animates out). A good board is roof kumquat, awning orchid, counter ychrys, bumper bamboo, which scores 3 stars with HK$440. The taboo complaint goes to store.bubble, not to the conversation log. Next: test real audio once a valid key is in place.
